caption: Set sleep timer
format: Set sleep timer of {TARGET, object} to {VALUE} min
description: Sets the sleep timer of the zone in minutes. 0 switches the timer off.

de.Sets the sleep timer of the zone in minu: Setzt den Einschlaf-Timer der Zone in Minuten. 0 schaltet den Timer aus.
de.Set sleep timer of {TARGET, object} to {: Einschlaf-Timer von {TARGET, object} auf {VALUE} min setzen
